Title: HDInsight: HBase cluster type supports cluster scaling

Body.Content: In addition to Hadoop and Storm cluster types, the Cluster Scaling feature is also supported by HBase clusters. You can seamlessly add or remove nodes to your HBase cluster while it is running. Regional servers are automatically balanced within a few minutes of completing the scaling operation. Refer to Cluster scaling in HDInsight for more information.
